description.value: Commercial Street Cafe is an independent coffee shop in Vancouver's Cedar Cottage neighbourhood, housed in the heritage Gow Block building on historic Commercial Street just minutes from Trout Lake. Opened in 2012 by long-time neighbourhood residents, it has become a community staple serving Timbertrain espresso alongside a wide range of largely house-baked goods. Its unpretentious, welcoming character and proximity to Trout Lake make it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the area.
